items.html: And therefore it is called 'goes out of Eden,' because she was attached to Hochma, and went out to nurse the son. For at first, until the time of birth, they were attached one to the other face to face, like the coupling of a man and his wife, and they would not separate, in the manner that Adam HaRishon went out, except that they were matched face to face. After the Atik was corrected, in order to nurse the son, Hochma was forced to be engraved in the form of male and female, this one protruding and this one recessed, and it went out outside on account of her son. And this is the matter of 'this Hochma was engraved.'
